confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Bratislava and Slovak/euro-area price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hostel and hotel anchors, which vary more by season and property. Cocktail and wine_glass are direct estimates rather than beer-derived. FX provenance is weaker than the anchors: the 0.6955 observation for 2026-10-15 came from a search summary attributed to the RBA, but I could not confirm the value on the rba.gov.au page itself. Another search returned an RBA cached table dated only to March 2026, and a standard search returned a cached RBA table to 31 December 2025, so the date and value should be checked against the official RBA daily table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Central European capitals with similar tourism demand and euro-area pricing, such as Ljubljana, Budapest, and Prague, with Bratislava priced somewhat below Vienna, which is about an hour away by road.
